effects.before: No shared pure value kept owner-minted logical, captured content/revision, observed projection and presentation occurrence identities separate.
effects.after: Core now constructs those axes separately, retains extraction gaps and refuses an occurrence whose observation differs; repeated inclusion can share logical/captured identity while retaining distinct occurrence IDs.

effects.before: No shared pure value preserved arbitrary resource octets and distinguished original byte spans, projected text positions and typed unavailable location.
effects.after: Core now carries exact non-UTF8 resource bytes, captured revision, explicit position basis and unavailable reasons; projected Markdown cannot become original XML bytes without a retained reverse map.

user_impact.reason: Rust clients gain pure identity/location values; none maps an opaque resource to an unrestricted host path or authorizes I/O.

documentation_impact.reason: Document exact identity axes and coordinate-basis limits, including unavailable reverse mappings and non-UTF8 resources.
